overview: Gilbert called from the Bell. He had run from the shop. The fire was last week, and the accounts did not agree: half the High Street, Henley Street, forty houses, and then Hobbins's twenty at the north end. There was a letter in Anne's hand, and Hobbins would give it to nobody else. You said you were coming. The call stopped before the commendation was finished.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Said he was coming, and did not get an answer about the house.
